FIRESTONES ARE SPEEDWAY-PROVED FOR YOUR TURNPIKE SAFETY!
Year after year, at Daytona, Darlington and nearly every other stock car track in the country,
Firestone racing tires have rolled up more wins and more world and track records than any other
tire. Yet that's only the beginning of the story. For this is where Firestone speedway research
helps build outstanding improvements into every Firestone tire. Two of them are Firestone
Rubber-X *, longest-wearing rubber ever used in Firestone tires, and tough Firestone Safety-
Fortified cord. You get the full benefit of such developments in the remarkable new Firestone
Nylon "500"—made with a revolutionary one-piece molded Power Tread that puts twice as
many more center action traction edges on the road. At the same time, mileage is increased
by as much as 35%! Put a set on your car today at your nearby Firestone Dealer or Store.
